reviews.text:
Emma has been absolutely fantastic with Madigan. She walked him twice a week and I always felt completely confident he was in great hands. Madigan is an energetic dog and Emma handled him with ease, patience, and genuine care.

She was consistently reliable, communicative, and clearly has a natural connection with dogs. Every time Madigan came back from a walk he was happy, relaxed, and clearly well exercised (mentally and physically). It was obvious he really enjoyed his time with her.

It’s not easy to trust someone with your dog, but Emma made it effortless. I would highly recommend her to anyone looking for a dependable and thoughtful dog walker. Madigan and I are both very grateful for the care she gave him.

Emma is honestly one of a kind when it comes to looking after & training dogs. Her attention to detail, kindness & patience is unmatched.

She always puts dogs' needs first and you can tell it pays off - our Pesto adores her!

Would highly recommend her 🙏🏼
Emma did amazing job taking care, training and socializing our puppy!

Most importantly Emma is clearly a dog lover and bonded with our lab immediately... and he loved her right back.
Secondly Emma is thoroughly professional - communication is clear and timely... which is brilliant.
Finally.. Emma also understands that many of us worry when away from our pets and so she posts photos of your pet while out walking with her which is wonderfully reassuring. Something she clearly understands.
I would recommend her service without any hesitation at all. Emma you are a star!

Emma was so helpful, arranging with very little notice, to take our golden retriever for walks over a 4 week period. She was dependable, trustworthy and took great care of our  dog. We had absolute peace of mind and also photos after each walk.

We used Pawfit's pet sitting service while we were away on holidays for a week.Emma looked after our cavapoo dog ' Benji' and al
so minded our house.We were very happy with Emma .She provided us with photos of Benji and continual updates on him.She is completely trustworthy and professional and we would highly recommend her to look after your dog.

Superb service. Reliable, professional and most importantly, my dogs love their walks. Great communication.

Its also commendable that Pawfit walks my rescue dog and has helped him with his nervous behavior. I would recommend Pawfit without a second thought.
Best pet & home sitter ever !

Emma and John have been an absolute blessing taking care of my dog Sarah (and my house) for 6 days. From the first moment until even after they have left, they kept being involved with the care for Sarah.
Sarah was not feeling well when I left, adding the fact that she is a very old dog, involved some risks for Emma. However, she is an absolute professional and made me feel at ease since the moment we connected.
Emma is very well organised, precise in following my rhythm with my dog, so attentive in communicating daily while I was away by keeping me fully updated on how things went. I have never received so many beautiful pictures of Sarah. Honestly, I couldn’t have wished for a better first experience.
Punctual and professional service. Highly recommended.

Our dog loved Emma and her team! We were set up with weekly walks for our pup and we were thrilled with how much fun she had, and how tired she came home. Emma is super organized, very responsive and took such good care of our dog. We are so happy we found her and we wouldn’t hesitate to recommend her to anyone looking for some extra walks and care for their pet.

When we lived in Seaport, Emma and her team were beloved by our four-year-old golden retriever. Daisy had a great relationship with all of them and would return home from her weekly walks happy, tired and sometimes a little sandy from the beach. No matter, Emma would hose her off and clean her up if she needed it. We have since moved back to the states, but when we get around to hiring a dogwalker here, Pawfit will be the standard by which they will be measured.

Emma and her team at Pawfit have been taking my dog for walks for the past three years and I couldn't recommend them more highly. They treat Bella with such kindness, pairing her walks with dogs that they know she will have great fun with, …
Pawfit took great care of our boy, and were very accommodating as he got older and needed to slow down. It was comforting to know he was well looked after while we were at work.

Emma made dog coaching easy for me to understand so that I was not accidently reinforcing unwanted behaviors but without being "mean". rewarding good stuff is the way to go.  Lots of treats and games do learning is fun... Bess is always exhausted after but is always delighted to spot Emma coming across the park....

Emma looked after my dog and 2 cats recently and she was fantastic. She was very friendly and a natural with the animals. She kept me updated constantly and I immediately felt like I could focus on my work trip and not need to check in on …

Highly recommend Pawfit for dog walking. Emma and her team are professional, careful and love dogs! Emma has walked our high energy working cocker spaniel for over 2 years and we’ve been very happy with the service. Emma is reliable, …

I cannot recommend Emma enough! Her expertise, patience, and dedication as a dog trainer is incredible. She worked with my bichon frise to address destructiveness at home, and the results have been wonderful. Emma not only helped my dog …

Emma shared her professional skills as a judge at the Monkstown Tidy District Dog Show, Sept.2024. She also offered vouchers for dog walking or training to two lucky winners! Thanks for volunteering Emma. You were brilliant and kind to  both dogs and owners.

Emma provides a wonderful service that we couldn’t do without. The pups simply adore her and we are always relaxed and happy knowing our two special doggies look forward to their walkies and sleep overs.
